svg.title: Durable evidence, telemetry and recovery
svg.desc: Treasury commits state before grant; telemetry is delivered by an outbox. Live sockets remain process-local. Source-verified EntraGuard flow. Official Microsoft architecture icons.

text.tspan: Durable evidence, telemetry and recovery
Treasury commits state before grant; telemetry is delivered by an outbox. Live sockets remain process-local.
Microsoft Azure
EntraGuard · verified logical flows
NUMBERED INTERACTIONS · time runs downward · dashed = response / conditional interaction (not every branch runs)
STEP DETAILS / DECISION RULES
Numbers match the interaction on the left.
Coordinator
Table Storage
Outbox worker
DCE / DCR / logs
Sentinel
Operator console
Begin Treasury attempt
01 Before dialing, conditionally commit receipt, reverse-time
history and recovery work with a 15-minute deadline.
SignalR live events
02 Publish live call/transcript/assessment or verification events
to authorized home-tenant operators. This is not durable replay.
Atomic completion
03 Commit final receipt/history, an outbox row and optional
notification; remove recovery work.
Scan every 15 seconds
04 Read recovery work first, then pending outbox work. This is a
hosted worker inside the Media Service.
Expire unfinished attempt
05 After its deadline, mark a pending Treasury attempt CallFailed
through FinishAsync. Audio is not resumed.
Deliver verification telemetry
06 Convert the receipt to telemetry and upload through
LogsIngestionSink using the configured DCE and DCR.
Delete acknowledged work
07 Delete outbox work only after a successful sink result.
Failure retries; acknowledgement loss can produce duplicates.
Other direct telemetry
08 EAM verification, monitored-call analysis/remediation,
biometrics and faults use direct sink paths rather than
Treasury's outbox.
Scheduled risk analytics
09 The Bicep high-risk-call rule runs every five minutes over
CallAnalysis data. A call does not automatically become an
incident.
Direct incident tool
10 Permitted monitored-call remediation can create a Sentinel
incident immediately, separately from the scheduled rule.
Server-side KQL reads
11 The operator portal reads Log Analytics; it also reads Graph
and Resource Graph for its other views.
Durable receipt for grants
12 Grant/payment checks read durable state. A restart loses live
sockets and EAM flow state, not existing Treasury receipts.
IMPLEMENTATION NOTES
Five custom streams: CallAnalysis, Remediation, Verification, Biometric and Fault. Bicep configures 30-day retention; full transcript Blob archiving is absent.
Receipts exclude match codes, expected answers and transcript text. Analysis telemetry may contain evidence/excerpts, truncated to 4,000 characters for TranscriptWindow.
Source/configuration review · 20 September 2026 · not a live deployment audit · original Microsoft icons; see asset credits and source references in the companion guide.
